scope: StageA2-style factor branches after the exact good-prime and support-Legendre2 layers, with rank-zero reconstruction pruning replayed from the certified rank-zero species.
reduction_lemma: If a rational branch point exists, scale [T:S] to coprime integers. For every odd support prime p, at least one of T,S is nonzero modulo p. Each auxiliary square root is p-integral: from F=delta*r^2 with F integral and delta an integral squareclass representative, v_p(F)-v_p(delta)=2v_p(r) and v_p(F)>=0 force v_p(r)>=0 whenever the equation is rationally soluble. Therefore reduction modulo p gives a projective F_p point satisfying all four reduced square equations.
finite_test: For each [T:S] in P1(F_p) and each factor F_i with squareclass delta_i: if p divides delta_i require F_i=0 mod p; otherwise require F_i/delta_i to be a quadratic residue mod p (zero allowed). If no projective [T:S] passes, the branch has no Q-point.
credit_boundary: Only a branch with no projective reduction at an odd support prime is globally excluded. Every surviving branch remains only a necessary-condition survivor; no rational point, receiver closure, or all-multiples credit follows.
